personality_one_liner: A personal financial advisor in your pocket — premium, trustworthy, calm, and transparent.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native vertical spacing. Padding creates clear breathing room around forms and financial data.

do's: Use frosted glass on the '15% Cash Refund' hero banner
Use glass headers over scrolling dashboard content
dont's: No glass on standard loan type cards

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Introduce BorrowRight benefits and guide to Auth.
screens.layout: Full bleed 'welcome_bg' abstract background. Vertical gradient scrim from transparent to surfaceInverse. 2x2 grid of feature cards (Compare Banks, Lower Cost, Fast Process, Dedicated RM) placed over the scrim. Large sticky 'Get Started' button fixed at safe-area bottom.

screens.name: Auth (OTP)
screens.purpose: Securely log the user in via Mobile OTP or Google.
screens.layout: Large minimal typography. Huge input area for 10-digit mobile. Large 4-box OTP input. Sticky 'Continue' button bound to KeyboardAvoidingView. Minimalist 'Google Login' secondary button.

screens.name: KYC Onboarding
screens.layout: Progress bar at top (e.g., Step 1 of 3). Clean, single-column stacked input fields (Name, PAN, Aadhaar, Income). Sticky Continue button at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central hub for loan tracking, RM contact, and quick actions.
screens.layout: Glass header with Profile and Notification icons. Top hero banner: 15% Cash Refund using 'cash_refund_bg' + glass overlay + warning (Gold) accent. Next: 'Track Application' horizontal pipeline card. Next: 2x2 or horizontal scroll 'Loan Types' with brandTertiary tinted Phosphor icons. Next: 'Relationship Manager' contact card with 'rm_avatar'. Next: EMI Calculator mini-widget.

states.error: Failed to load dashboard data + Retry

screens.name: Loan Tracker
screens.layout: Clean vertical stepper. Active step has brandPrimary filled dot, brandPrimary bold text. Future steps have surfaceTertiary dot. A continuous vertical gray line connects them. Each step shows timestamp if completed.

states.empty: No active application - Prompt to apply

screens.name: Bank Comparison
screens.layout: Horizontal snap-scrolling cards. Each card has Bank Name/Logo (initials fallback), Interest Rate, EMI. One card highlighted with a 'Best Value' top badge and brandPrimary borderStrong.

screens.name: Document Upload
screens.purpose: Securely upload KYC and property docs.
screens.layout: Header lock icon. 1-2 large dashed dropzones for PAN/Aadhaar. A massive brandPrimary sticky CTA for 'Submit'. Also, a distinct full-width 'WhatsApp Document Submission' secondary card using the 'whatsapp_icon' PNG.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design follows the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality with 'Modern Premium FinTech' vibes, inspired by high-end financial platforms. ZERO blue or purple tones permitted.
Brand colors are deep Forest Green (#0A3B2A) with Amber/Gold highlights (#D4AF37) for premium offers like the Cash Refund banner.

For the Welcome Screen and Dashboard Hero, use the provided 'welcome_bg' and 'cash_refund_bg' images with the mandatory vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast. Ensure text overlay on images uses onSurfaceInverse.

Forms must use clean, large tap areas (44x44pt minimum) with labels positioned strictly above inputs. Single column only. Place primary CTAs sticky at the bottom over scrolling content, wrapped in a keyboard-avoiding view where applicable.
The Loan Status Tracker must visualize an 8-stage vertical pipeline. Active/Completed steps use brandPrimary, inactive use surfaceTertiary. It must look sleek and not overwhelming.
Use Phosphor icons consistently with weight=regular. Absolutely no emojis.
Bank logos failed to return transparent PNGs from Unsplash; implement the Initials Fallback strategy (e.g., 'HDFC', 'SBI') in a brandTertiary circle.
Incorporate a dedicated card for the Relationship Manager using 'rm_avatar', featuring 'Call' and 'Chat' action buttons.
Ensure 'Secure Upload' trust signals are prominent on the Document Upload screen, utilizing appropriate Phosphor lock/shield icons.
